summary: InkBound full-stack review. Backend: 23/23 pytest passing on public URL (auth register/login/me/logout, styles, parlours list+style/q filters, parlour/artist details, booking slots/create with conflict/auth, /bookings/me, /bookings/artist, PATCH status with role checks + 403 for third-party, review post updates parlour rating/review_count). Frontend UI on mobile viewport (390x844): demo login for both customer and artist works; discover list/map toggle works (web fallback via testID discover-map-web is shown as expected since react-native-maps has no web renderer); style chip filter works; parlour detail Gallery/Artists/Reviews tabs functional; posting a review works; full 4-step booking flow (Service->Date->Time->Confirm) creates a booking and lands on My Bookings; Cancel action on My Bookings works; sign out works and returns to /login; artist demo can see the Studio tab and reach the dashboard (Total counter reflects bookings). One caching bug identified: react-query cache is NOT cleared/invalidated on signOut, so when switching from customer to artist the artist dashboard initially shows a stale count (observed Total=2 but Pending=0 despite an actually-pending Mara Voss booking) until a manual refresh. Additionally seed uses deprecated FastAPI on_event handlers (not blocking).

minor.issue: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') and 'shutdown' are deprecated. Migrate to lifespan context manager.

ui_bugs.issue: React-query cache is not cleared on sign out. After signing out as customer and signing in as artist, the artist Studio dashboard shows stale pending/confirmed counters (observed Total=2 with Pending=0 while a Pending booking existed for ar_1). Fix: on signOut and on successful sign-in, call queryClient.clear() (or invalidate/removeQueries for ['bookings'] scope).

issues: Horizontal day carousel has no visible affordance/indicator that it scrolls beyond 5 days. Consider adding a subtle right-edge fade or arrow.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime warning: Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported on web. Wrap or gate useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' (or ignore) to silence warnings during web preview testing.
Runtime warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents instead. Search for `pointerEvents=` prop usages in components (likely GradientScrim/overlay wrappers) and move to style.

action_items: In src/auth/auth-context.tsx, import the queryClient and call queryClient.clear() (or removeQueries({queryKey:['bookings']}) + removeQueries({queryKey:['parlours']})) inside signOut, and also after successful signInEmail/signUpEmail/signInGoogle, so state from a previous user does not leak.
Replace FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') with a lifespan context manager to remove the DeprecationWarning.
Sweep the frontend for `pointerEvents=` prop usages and move them to style.pointerEvents (RN Web deprecation).
Gate any useNativeDriver:true animations by Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the recurring web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user handles expired sessions manually; combined with the TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at this is fine but comment that Mongo purges expired docs asynchronously.

server.py PATCH /bookings/{id}/status allows a customer 'owner' to set status to 'confirmed'/'completed'/'declined' too — consider restricting non-cancel transitions to the artist role only (currently a customer could self-confirm their own booking).

seed_data.py uses fixed rating/review_count numbers, but POST /reviews recomputes them from stored reviews only; seeded review_count (e.g. 128) will collapse to the count of actually-stored reviews on the first new review. Recommend seeding reviews to match, or use $inc-only updates.
seed_data_creation: Created a Mara Voss (ar_1) pending booking via UI to seed artist dashboard; other TEST_ prefixed reviews/bookings created via pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://tattoo-spots.preview.emergentagent.com and demo creds are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Booking flow is 4 steps and needs a click on booking-next between each. Dashboard-cache-after-signout bug requires signing out as customer then signing in as artist and observing Studio counters (should reflect fresh /api/bookings/artist).
rca_of_issue: Bug: Stale Studio dashboard counters after user switch. RCA: signOut in src/auth/auth-context.tsx clears the auth token but never touches the react-query cache. QueryClient is created once at the app root, so cached responses keyed as ['bookings','artist'] (which returned [] under a non-artist user) survive the auth swap and are served to the newly-logged-in artist until a manual pull-to-refresh. Reproduction: 1) log in as customer, book Mara Voss (ar_1) - booking is Pending; 2) sign out from Profile; 3) log in as artist demo; 4) open Studio tab -> Pending count is 0 even though the booking is pending. Mitigation: import queryClient in auth-context and call queryClient.clear() inside signOut, and after every successful sign-in call queryClient.invalidateQueries() (or clear()).
